linkedin:
New in the Vital Acoustica rig: LED neon flex.

Neon flex is a flexible LED light in a soft jacket that bends to almost any outline and glows evenly along its whole length, without the visible dots of an ordinary LED strip. It gives the look of glass neon in a form that can be shaped on site, coiled for transport and reused event after event.

Where it works well at an event:

1. Outlining structures. Running it along a stage edge, a DJ booth, a bar front or a truss line defines the space and reads clearly on camera.

2. Shapes and lettering. Bent into curves, loops or simple shapes, it can carry an event's theme into the room without printed signage.

3. Colour that matches the show. Set to the same palette as the rest of the lighting, it ties the décor and the stage together, and it can change with the music.

The honest limit: neon flex is a decorative and accent light, not a light for lighting people or stages. It is about lines and shapes, so it works best alongside the main rig rather than instead of it.

The short video shows it in a few of its colours, straight out of the case.

It is now available to hire alongside the rest of our lighting.
